spans.s:
(शि) r. 6th cl. (गुडति)
To defend, to guard or preserve.
(इ) गुडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (गुण्डति गुण्डयति)
1 To surround, to enclose.
2 To pound, to grind, to reduce to powder.
3 (According to some authorities,) To preserve.

mfn. (-डः-डा-डं)
Round, globular.
m. (-डः)
1 A globe or ball.
2 Treacle, molasses, the first thickening of the juice of the cane by boiling.
3 An elephant's trappings or armour.
4 A mouthful.
f. (-डा)
1 A plant, (Euphorbia tirucalli^1): see स्नुही.
2 Powder, pounded substance.
E.
गुङ् to sound, affix ड.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-कः)
A conserve, a drug prepared with treacle.
n. (-कं)
Treacle.
E.
गुड, and कन् added.

f. (-का)
Sloth.

f. (-री)
One of the female personifications of the musical modes.

f. (-ची)
A plant, (Menispermum glabrum): see गुडुची.

n. (-णं)
Sugar cane.
E.
गुड raw sugar, and तृण grass.

n. (-त्वक्)
The aromatic bark of the Laurus cassia.
E.
गुड sugar, and त्वच् skin, bark, sweet-bark; also गुडत्वच.

Mace.
2

Cassia bark.
E.
गुड sugar, sweet as sugar, त्वच् bark, and अच् added in this form of the compound.

m. (-रुः)
Sugar cane.
E.
गुड raw sugar, and दारु wood.

f. (-नुः)
Sugar piled up for distribution at certain religious rites.
E.
गुड, and धेनु a cow.

n. (-ष्टं)
A sort of sweetmeat, flour or rice and sugar, ground and boiled together.
E.
गुड, and पिष्ट ground.

m. (-ष्पः)
A kind of bassia, (B. latifolia.)
E.
गुड sugar, and पुष्प flower; the flowers being full of saccharine matter.

m. (-लः)
A tree, commonly Pilu, (Careya arborea, &c.): see पीलु.
E.
गुड, and फल fruit, the fruit yielding Gur or saccharine matter.

n. (-श्रं)
A sort of cake or sweetmeat, flour or rice and coarse sugar ground and boiled together.
E.
गुड, and मिश्र mixed.

m. (-लः)
A kind of amaranth, (A. polygamus); also अल्पमारिष.
E.
गुड, and मूल root; having a root as sweet as Gur.

n. (-लं)
A spirituous liquor distilled from molasses, a sort of rum.
E.
गुड sugar, and ल what requires.

f. (-रा)
Sugar, refined sugar.
E.
गुड molasses, and शर्क्करा sugar or sand.

m. (-ग्रुः)
A red sort of morunga: see शोभाञ्जन.
E.
गुड sugar, शिग्रु morunga.

m. (-शः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

A title of ARJUNA.
E.
गुडा Euphorbia, and केश the hair; the hair forming matted locks, resembling in shape the leaves of the Euphorbia: again, गुडाका sloth, and ईश paramount; subduing indolence.

m. (-यः)
A mountain Pilu: see गुडफल.

f. (-का)
A pill, a bolus.
E.
गुड to be round, वुन् aff.

f. (-ची)
A plant: see the next.

f. (-ची)
A creeper, commonly called Guricha, (Menispermum glabrum.)
E.
गुड to preserve, (from disease,) ऊचट् affix; also with the pen. vowel short गुडुची.

m. (-रः)
A mouthful.
E.
गुड to surround, एरक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
A mouthful.
E.
गुड to preserve, एरक् affix, and कन् added; also गुडेर.

f. (-वा)
Sugar.
E.
गुड, and उद्भव produced.

m. (-नं)
Boiled rice and coarse sugar.
E.
गुड, and ओदन rice.
